chip.description: ARM7-family 32-bit RISC core, designed by Advanced RISC Machines and embedded as a licensed core inside many ASICs and systems-on-chip (e.g. the ARM7DI inside the Yamaha AICA, the core of the IGS 027A).
chip.notes: Not a standalone package on most boards that list it: MAME instantiates the execution core separately from its host chip.
